purpose: Source-backed closure of all eight raw occupational-code values recorded in the domain-definition library.
canonical_rule: Only valid ISCO-08 unit groups remain canonical. Legacy ISCO-88 values may be retained only with an official ILO correspondence and a semantic check. Invalid values are removed from canonical anchors and preserved in this audit.

records.action: Replace the legacy anchor with ISCO-08 2120 in the canonical occupational evidence layer.
records.reason: The ILO correspondence table maps ISCO-88 2121 to ISCO-08 2120. The old value is therefore not an unexplained guess; it is a legacy code with an official correspondence.
records.evidence_note: The official ILO correspondence table is used where a legacy ISCO-88 meaning exists. Absence from the official unit-group structure is treated as a closed invalid-code finding, not as permission to invent a replacement.
